import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(77)
n = 500
k = rng.integers(0, 3, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (3, 10))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
df['label'] = [f'item_{i}' for i in range(n)]
# All rows point to the same test PNG served by the harness /images/ route.
df['image_path'] = 'test_img.png'

steps.name: set image URL column to image_path
steps.eval: const imgCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'image_path').index; a.tooltipOpts = { ...a.tooltipOpts, imageUrlColumn: imgCol, fieldMode: 'all' }

steps.name: hover first anchor
steps.eval: const xy = a.anchorXY; a['onPointer']({ x: 400, y: 300, world: [xy[0], xy[1]] })
